question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He was very __cruel__ in dealing with the students.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cruel"** means showing a willingness to cause pain or suffering to others. (क्रूर)

 
 
• **Example: **The dictator was known for his cruel treatment of political prisoners.
 
 
 
• **"Kind"** refers to being friendly, generous, and considerate; the opposite of cruel. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her kind nature and always helps those in need.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cruel'** is **'kind'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Skittish **(चंचल): Nervous or easily frightened.

 
 
• **Example:** The skittish horse refused to cross the bridge.
 
 
 
• **Malevolent **(दुर्भावनापूर्ण): Having or showing a wish to do evil to others.
 
 
• **Example: **Her malevolent glare made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Kingly** (राजसी): Befitting a king; regal.
 
 
• **Example:** He wore a kingly robe at the ceremony.
